response:
It's not weird, and you're not alone in this—many people struggle with turning frustration inward when they make mistakes. What you're describing sounds really painful, and it makes sense that you'd want to understand it. The fact that you're asking shows a lot of self-awareness.

I want to gently point out that hurting yourself when you're upset is a sign that you're carrying more pain than anyone should have to manage alone. You're not stupid—making mistakes is part of being human, even though I know that can be hard to believe in the moment. If you can, please consider talking to a doctor or counselor about this; they can help you find gentler ways to cope with those intense feelings. If the urge to hurt yourself ever feels overwhelming, reaching out to a crisis line (like 988 in the US) can help too. You deserve support and kindness, especially from yourself.
